items.label: Waterproof & Windproof & Lightweight & Warm
items.value: Outer sleek fabric is treated to repel water while maintaining breathability. Polyester synthetic material of the lining helps improve the breathability and transfer the moisture away quickly. Mid layer is waterproof membrane, effectively prevents rainwater seeping into the garment and keeps you dry and comfortable. (8000MM fabric waterproof rating, 1000G/M2/24hr fabric breathability rating)

items: Windbreaker Jacket with Removable Hood：The detachable zip-off hood is adjustable with velcro on the back that keeps you well protected in rainy and windy days. Stand collar and adjustable waistband & hem offer a better fit and fashion style. Premium SBS zippers are smooth and long-lasting and zipper pullers have reflective elements for low-light visibility.

items.label: Warm but Not Bulky
items.value: Made of high quality lightweight materials. Microfleece lining is very soft and comfortable to keep you warm without being bulky.

items.label: 4 Roomy Pockets
items.value: There are 2 outside zippered security pockets and 2 inside patch pockets. It is great for storing money, keys, phone, wallet, passport, etc, providing great privacy and convenience for you.

items.label: Versatile
items.value: This women's fleece lined softshell rain jacket and windbreaker is suitable for casual wear or spring / fall / winter outdoor activities like outdoor sports, working, walking, hiking, traveling, cycling, mountaineering, camping, climbing, fishing, hunting, running, etc.

items.label: Lining Description
items.value: Made of high-quality microfleece, the lining is soft and comfortable, providing warmth without adding bulk.
